contract: Volatile exact-key duplicate suppression by sender/incarnation/sequence. Duplicate detection/receiver behavior has test evidence; proofs cover only emit with an already-computed duplicate flag.
limits: History is unbounded and discarded on restart.
No bounded window, durability, exactly-once effects or cross-sender ordering.
seen/receiver duplicate detection is test-grounded, not covered by the two emit helper proofs.

grounding.claim: The duplicate output decision emits nothing for any message.
The fresh output decision preserves any message.
The pinned Cure compiler checks this source before emitting its BEAM.
The named scenarios in this ExUnit file are executable evidence, not universal proofs.
Relies on the pinned provider implementation and public contract.

telemetry.contract: This scoped callable has no independent running lifecycle; the invoking Unit or Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Explicit function inputs/state determine behavior; no ambient or mutable runtime settings are supplied.

control.contract: This scoped callable has no independent runtime lifecycle to pause, drain or resume.
